comparison: Vul-RAG vs Code RAG on PairVul (Table 4)
model_config: Same four online LLMs: GPT-4o, Claude Sonnet 3.5, Qwen2.5-Coder-32B-Instruct, and DeepSeek-R1
arm_a: Vul-RAG: extracted functional-semantics retrieval plus distilled vulnerability knowledge
arm_b: Code RAG: code-only retrieval plus raw retrieved code snippets
other_changes: Retrieval strategy changes: Vul-RAG adds extracted functional semantics to retrieval, so retrieved examples differ.
quote: In the retrieval phase, knowledge-level RAG more accurately retrieves semantically relevant vulnerabilities from the knowledge base, whereas code-level RAG often retrieves textually similar but semantically irrelevant vulnerabilities.
